item.title: US cities are axing Flock Safety surveillance technology
item.description:
📝 We weren't the only city to actively reject Flock cameras. Following intense public backlash, Ring cut ties with Flock just like my city did. Most concerning are the latest Flock drones equipped with high-powered cameras.

item.title: Mario and Earendil
item.description:
